channel.title: The Dancify blog
channel.description: Practical guides for dancers: filming yourself, learning choreography, counting music, keeping a practice diary and seeing your progress. From the makers of Dancify for iPhone and iPad.

item.title: How to film yourself dancing: angles, light and setup
item.description: How to film yourself dancing with a phone: camera height and distance for each style, the best angle, light, sound, phone stands and six mistakes to avoid.

item.title: How to learn choreography faster (and actually remember it)
item.description: How to learn choreography faster: map the piece, learn in eight-counts, mark it, use the mirror wisely, slow the video down, loop hard parts and film to check.

item.title: How to make a dance progress video that's honest and motivating
item.description: How to make a dance progress video: film the same combo the same way, how often, what to compare, sequence vs side-by-side vs grid, dates and sharing.

item.title: How to count music in dance: eight-counts, "5, 6, 7, 8" and finding the one
item.description: How to count music in dance: beats, bars and eight-counts, what "5, 6, 7, 8" means, finding the one, "and" counts, waltz in 3/4 and BPM by dance style.

item.title: How to keep a dance practice journal: what to track, with prompts
item.description: How to keep a dance practice journal: what to track after each class, a five-minute entry, journaling prompts for dancers and a weekly look back.

item.title: How to practise dance at home: space, warm-up and a weekly plan
item.description: How to practise dance at home: a safe space and floor, shoes or socks, warm-up, a 30-minute session, weekly plans for beginners and intermediates, rest.

item.title: The best apps for dancers in 2026, by what you need them for
item.description: The best apps for dancers in 2026 by job: STEEZY, Dancify, Dance.io, OnForm, CapCut, Edits, iMovie, Anytune and more, with a comparison table and no hype.

item.title: Why we built a dance practice app with no feed and no scores
item.description: The story behind Dancify: why dancers' practice videos get lost, the six decisions that shaped the app, what we left out on purpose, and what comes next.
